**T4C — Compliant (at fallback, with one preferred element exceeded).**

- **Our convenience right:** § 12.3 (p0590) lets AbbVie terminate "for any or no reason," in entirety or country-by-country, on 90 days' written notice — within the fallback 60–90 day band.
- **No early-termination fee:** the termination consequences (§§ 12.6.1, 12.7, 12.8, 12.10) are reversion and accrued-rights mechanics only; the § 6.1/6.2 non-refundable upfront and milestones are earned payments, not a termination charge, so the three-months cap is satisfied.
- **Harpoon has no convenience right:** its rights are limited to material breach (§§ 12.2.1–12.2.2) and insolvency (§ 12.4) — better than the fallback and meeting the preferred "no Vendor convenience termination" element.

Only preferred-level gaps are the 90-day (vs. 30-day) notice and the absence of a prepaid-fee pro-rata refund, which is immaterial in this milestone/royalty structure. Noted in the rationale; no redline proposed.
